# Kaleem

> Kaleem (كليم) is an Iraqi digital solutions company based in Basra and Baghdad. We get organizations' data out of old, locked systems, convert it to open standards, rebuild their websites, apps and systems, and hand over every key — code, data, domain and accounts — in the client's name. Site is bilingual — English at /en/, Arabic at /ar/.

## Primary sections

- [Home](https://kaleem.dev/en/): what we do, how we work, and our values
- [Services](https://kaleem.dev/en/services/): six services — The Jailbreak (data liberation), websites and web apps, mobile apps, management and store systems, networks and security, consulting and training — plus our working terms
- [Work](https://kaleem.dev/en/work/): case studies
- [Alimran Medical Center case study](https://kaleem.dev/en/al-imran/): 600 articles extracted from a legacy WordPress site and rebuilt on Astro and Cloudflare Workers
- [About](https://kaleem.dev/en/about/): our story, mission and values
- [Contact](https://kaleem.dev/en/contact/): phone, WhatsApp, email and a free audit
